sloka: अस्मिन् काले तु यद्युक्तं तदिदानीं विधीयताम् ।गतं तु नानुशोचन्ति गतं तु गतमेव हि ।। ६.६३.२५ ।।
transliteration: asmin kāle tu yadyuktaṁ tadidānīṁ vidhīyatām ।gataṁ tu nānuśocanti gataṁ tu gatameva hi ।। 6.63.25 ।।

translations.english: "You may speak of only what is proper to do now. Do not think of the past as it is gone."
